summary: Correction: the $3.50 UpCloud row was labeled “Developer 1 GB”, a plan UpCloud now lists as discontinued. Renamed to the orderable Starter 1 GB ($3.50, 250 Mbit/s, max 5 per customer), Premium 1 GB ($6) verified and Starter 4 GB / 2 vCPU ($14) added, all re-read from UpCloud’s global pricing page. UpCloud Simple Backup (+20%) is now counted when backups are on. Discontinued plans are never ranked or suggested.

Correction: our verdicts, rankings and savings figures left out Vultr’s published 20% backup fee while the tables on the same pages included it. Vultr vc2-2c-4gb was shown as $20.00/mo “with backups” (and $106/yr cheaper than DigitalOcean); the true cost is $24.00/mo and the gap is $57.60/yr. Affected 19 pages. One fee policy now applies everywhere (every fee we hold is counted in tables, verdicts, rankings, widget and calculator), Vultr backup (20%) and overage ($0.01/GB) and Hetzner backup (20%) are now verified from official docs, and a build check fails if any verdict price differs from its own table.

Re-checked: all 8 Cost-Optimized plans (CX23, CX33, CX43, CX53, CAX11, CAX21, CAX31, CAX41) are marked “not available” (“This product is currently unavailable. Please check back later.”). Cost-Optimized is listed for eu-central NBG1/HEL1 only.

Correction: VPSLedger’s “Are you overpaying?” check, calculator and guides had suggested switching to Hetzner CX23/CX33 although Hetzner lists them as unavailable since our 2026-10-26 check. They are now labeled “Sold out” and “EU only” and are no longer suggested as switch targets; savings figures were recomputed from orderable plans only.

Correction to the Black Friday VPS guide: it bolded Hostinger as lowest for each RAM size but compared it only with Vultr and DigitalOcean, leaving out cheaper no-prepay plans in our own ledger. OVHcloud VPS-1 (2 vCPU / 4 GB, $5.35/mo, no commitment, re-read 2026-10-31) costs $64.20 / $128.40 / $192.60 over 1/2/3 years vs Hostinger KVM 1 $155.76 / $155.76 / $443.52, and OVHcloud VPS-2 (4 vCPU / 8 GB, $10/mo) is lower than KVM 2 at 1 and 3 years. The guide now adds the cheapest verified, in-stock, no-prepay plan per RAM size and a build check fails if a 'lowest' label skips a cheaper row. The 3-year column assumed a 12-month renewal Hostinger doesn't show (KVM 1 $299.64); it now uses the stated same-term renewal (24 months billed up front at month 25): KVM 1 $443.52, KVM 2 $570.72, KVM 4 $1,007.52, KVM 8 $1,823.52. Sale window Oct 19 – Dec 14, 2026 added from Hostinger's Black Friday page.

Black Friday VPS guide now covers 5 vendors with a price read on their own page today, not just Hostinger: RackNerd VPS specials (4 GB $59.99/yr, 8 GB $119.99/yr; the vendor says they renew at the same rate), ScalaHosting managed cloud (Black Friday Oct 19 – Dec 1; Build #1 $22.46/mo on a 1-year term, renews at $54.95/mo), AwakeHost Cloud VPS (30% off the first month, code BLACKFRIDAY30, Oct 13 – Nov 30; VPS 4 $17.49 then $24.99/mo) and Bluehost (intro price, not labelled Black Friday; NVMe 4 $227.76 for 24 months, renews $11.99/mo). Devoster's announced sale (Nov 20 – Dec 2) is listed separately with its published prices. Each row now answers “Renews at the same price?” with the vendor's own words, and shows term, sale price, renewal and 1/2/3-year cash. New lowest 3-year cash: 4 GB RackNerd $179.97 (was OVHcloud VPS-1 $192.60), 8 GB RackNerd $359.97. netcup, Contabo, JustVPS, HostGator, GreenCloud and YouStable are on a watch list with no price. Next re-checks: Nov 27 and Nov 30.
Corrected VPS-1/2/3 list prices to no-commitment monthly $5.35/$10.00/$14.50 (was 12-mo upfront $4.54/$8.50/$12.32 shown as monthly). 12-mo prepay kept as promo_mo. Source: OVH US public catalog API.
CX23 and CX33 re-confirmed currently unavailable on Hetzner cost-optimized / cloud pages (badge: Currently not available).
CX23 (€5.99/mo) shown as “not available” / currently unavailable in listed locations.
KVM 1 promo $6.49/mo on 24-month term; renews at $11.99/mo.
“VPS 2027” range listed, VPS-1 from $4.54/mo (2 vCore, 4 GB).
G8 and GPU plans do not include bundled transfer; older plans include 0–20 TB.
KVM 2 promo $8.79/mo on 24-month term; renews at $14.99/mo.

Second 2026 increase, for new orders and any rescale only (servers ordered before keep their price; rescaling up or down, restoring a deleted server or moving it to a different-currency project switches it to the new price). EU, excl. VAT and IPv4: CPX22 €7.99 → €19.49, CPX32 €13.99 → €35.49, CX23 €3.99 → €5.49, CX33 €6.49 → €8.49; US: CPX11 €5.99 → €17.49, CPX21 €11.99 → €31.99. Logged late; VPSLedger now tracks orderable CPX22/CPX32 (EU) and CPX11/CPX21 (US). See /guides/hetzner-price-increase-2026.

VAT and IPv4: CX23 €2.99 → €3.99, CX33 €4.99 → €6.49, CPX22 €5.99 → €7.99, CPX32 €10.49 → €13.99; US: CPX11 €4.49 → €5.99, CPX21 €8.99 → €11.99. Logged late, from Hetzner's own price-adjustment page (archived copy); see /guides/hetzner-price-increase-2026.
